rules.text: Draft pill_en, pill_de, benefit_en and benefit_de when creating a ticket; re-check all four before Done, even when hide_from_release_notes is true.
rules.why: Tickets explain what people gain, and the same words become release notes in English and German.
rules.details: Pills have 2–4 words. Benefits have one or two positive, plain-language sentences, with the benefit first and few technical terms. Describe the gain for a non-technical user, including work under the hood. German is neutral, without direct address (for example: Tickets lassen sich jetzt leichter finden.). Do not invent translations for old tickets. Hidden tickets still need both languages. Release notes use actual linked tickets and recorded field snapshots; missing evidence stays a gap.
